title: Un Ke Dar Ki Bheek Achchi
roman: Bui hawas sun seem-o-zar ki bandagi achchi nahin
Un ke dar ki bheek achchi sarwari achchi nahin
Sarwari kya cheez hai un ki gadayi ke huzoor
Un ke dar ki bheek achchi sarwari achchi nahin
Un ki choukhat choom kar khud keh rahi hai sarwari
Un ke dar ki bheek achchi sarwari achchi nahin

Un ke dar ki bheek achchi sarwari achchi nahin
Sarwari paa kar bhi kehte hain gadayaan-e-huzoor
Un ke dar ki bheek achchi sarwari achchi nahin
Taaj khud raa kaasah kardah guyad aeen jaa taajwar
Un ke dar ki bheek achchi sarwari achchi nahin

Un ke dar ki bheek achchi sarwari achchi nahin

Us Raza-e-mustafaa se dushmani achchi nahin
Hujjat-ul-islam ay haamid Raza baba-e-man
Tum ko bin dekhe hamari zindagi achchi nahin
Khaak-e-Taybah ki talab mein khaak ho ye zindagi
Khaak-e-Taybah achchi apni zindagi achchi nahin
Aarzumandaan-e-gul kaanton se bachtey hain kahin
Khaar-e-Taybah se teri pehlu tahi achchi nahin

Jo rula de khoon aisi dil lagi achchi nahin
Dasht-e-Taybah chorh kar main saiyr-e-jannat ko chalun
Rehne dijiye shaykh ji deewangi achchi nahin
Jo junoon-e-khuld mein kawwon ko de baithe dharam
Aise andhey shaykh ji ki payrwi achchi nahin
Aql chaupaayon ko de baithe hakeem-e-thaanwi
Main na kehta tha ke sohbat deo ki achchi nahin
Yaad-e-jaanaan mein maaz Allah hash ki khabar
Yaad-e-jaanaan mein kisi se aagahi achchi nahin
Shaam-e-hijraan mein hamein hai justuju us mehar ki
Chaudhween ke chaand teri chaandni achchi nahin
Touq-e-tehzeeb-e-firangi torh daalo momino
Teergi anjaam hai ye roshni achchi nahin
Shaakh-e-gul par hi banayen ge anaadil aashiyaan
Barq se keh do ke hum se zid teri achchi nahin
Jo piya ko bhaaye Akhtar woh suhaana raag hai
Jis se na khush hon piya woh raagni achchi nahin
